title: Studio X

services.name: Kids Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: Our Adult Program offers classes seven days a week, tailored to all skill levels, from basic and foundational to advanced training. Each class is thoughtfully structured with a comprehensive curriculum to create an optimal learning environment for every student. Our Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Gi and NoGi classes are separated into three categories: Basics classes serve as an introduction to Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, focusing on the foundational techniques, positions, and concepts of the sport, as well as self-defense techniques and scenarios. These classes are open to everyone, regardless of experience-visitors and first-timers are welcomed and encouraged to join! All Levels classes are open to anyone

blurb: Studio X is New York City’s original Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy. Opening its doors in 1995 under the leadership of Professor Fabio Clemente, a pioneer of BJJ on the East Coast and 3x Pan American Champion, Studio X offers classes 7 days a week, brought to you by a passionate team of IBJJF World Champions, active high-level competitors, and lifelong students of the game.
